identification: Omega mechanical stopwatch, black crackle/textured finish case with crown-pusher and two side pushers, steel bow. Black dial, red OMEGA logo, red centre seconds hand, white 30-minute register at 12 (dial reads 1-30 outer / 31-60 inner seconds track, so a 30-second-per-turn 1/10 sec timer style), white chapter ring, 'SWISS MADE' at 6. Back painted in green with NATO stock number 6645-66-031-3804 (6645 = time measuring instruments, 66 = Australia): Australian Defence issue, likely 1970s. Same family as the Australian-issue 'Omega stop watch 6645 PN MG 6301 PW73/..' examples sold on eBay AU in 2024. Lot page: estimate A$120-180; bid dropdown starts at A$75, so current bid about A$70.
